annotations.title: Calculate PCB Trace Impedance & IPC-2152 Current

description: Compute single-ended characteristic impedance (Z0 in Ohms), edge-coupled differential pair impedance (Zdiff in Ohms), and finished copper thickness (mm) for outer-layer microstrip or inner-layer stripline transmission lines, alongside IPC-2152 current parameters. Call this tool during stackup planning or high-speed USB/PCIe/Ethernet/RF constraint setup before routing. Inputs use millimeters (mm) for trace_width_mm, trace_spacing_mm, and dielectric_height_mm, ounces (oz) for copper_weight_oz, and dimensionless relative permittivity for er. Returns JSON with mode, single_ended_z0_ohm, differential_zdiff_ohm, and copper_thickness_mm; adjust trace_width_mm iteratively if Z0 deviates from 50 Ohms.

copper_weight_oz.description: Finished copper weight in ounces per square foot (oz/ft^2), where 1.0 oz equals 0.0348 mm (35 um). Typical values: 0.5, 1.0, or 2.0.

current_amps.description: Target continuous DC current in Amperes (A) for IPC-2152 thermal sizing context. Example: 1.5.

dielectric_height_mm.description: Dielectric separation H in millimeters (mm) between the signal layer and nearest solid reference plane (>= 0.02 mm). Example: 0.19 for 7628 prepreg.

er.description: Relative dielectric constant (Dk / Er) of the PCB laminate or prepreg at operating frequency (>= 1.0). Example: 4.29 for FR-4 prepreg, 3.48 for Rogers RO4350B.

max_temp_rise_c.description: Maximum allowable conductor temperature rise above ambient in degrees Celsius (deg C) per IPC-2152. Example: 10.0 or 20.0.

mode.description: Transmission line geometry: 'microstrip' for outer layers (F.Cu/B.Cu over reference plane) or 'stripline' for inner layers sandwiched between two reference planes.

trace_spacing_mm.description: Edge-to-edge copper spacing S in millimeters (mm) between coupled differential pair traces, clamped to >= 0.02 mm. Example: 0.15.

trace_width_mm.description: Copper trace width W in millimeters (mm), clamped to >= 0.02 mm. Example: 0.25 for 50-Ohm microstrip on 4-layer FR-4.
